selection.split_disjointness: development full input interval [alert_start-30m, alert_end) must not overlap any scored interval; half-open endpoints allowed
selection.stratification_policy: Seeded sampling within eligible single-record fault-reason strata. Include every supported reason when at most ten; otherwise choose ten highest-count reasons, tie-break by reason text. Start one scored slot per chosen reason; allocate remaining slots to the most under-allocated supported reason deterministically. Reason labels are private and never written to public manifests.
